basic_info.description: Directly across the street from Dolores Park, Coldwell Banker is proud to offer 537-541 Dolores Street, a charming four-unit multifamily property in one of San Francisco's most iconic neighborhoods. Located steps from Dolores Park, this 1925 Edwardian building offers classic details like high ceilings, hardwood floors, and abundant natural light.    The 3,949 sq. ft. building sits on a 3,190 sq. ft. lot and features four units with period charm. Set on a prime block near Mission Dolores Park and popular spots like Tartine, Bi-Rite, and Valencia Street, the property is surrounded by top dining, entertainment, and transit.    This is a rare chance to own a character-rich building with strong upside in one of the city's most desirable rental markets.
